header.title: Confidential recruiter pitch: Head of Platform role (via Brightline Talent)

evidence: Dana described the client only as a Series C payments company headquartered in Lisbon with about 400 employees
The opportunity offered a base salary of €145,000–€165,000
The user agreed to a follow-up call on 8 October 2026
pieces.body: On 1 October 2026 I took a call from Dana Whitlock, a recruiter at Brightline Talent, about a Head of Platform role at an unnamed Series C payments company in Lisbon with about 400 employees. I was asked to keep the details confidential until the client agrees to disclose its name. The role would lead three platform teams (about 22 engineers) reporting to the CTO, with a base salary of €145,000–€165,000, a 15% annual bonus target and equity Dana called 'meaningful' without a number. It is fully remote within Portugal, with an optional Lisbon office, and the client wants a start in January 2027. The hiring process has four stages: a CTO call, a system design session, a leadership panel and a reference check. I told Dana I'm interested, but I have not managed more than one team before, and I want the equity terms in writing before going further. A follow-up call is set for 8 October 2026, after Dana confirms whether the client will reveal its name.
pieces.title: Brightline Talent pitch for unnamed Lisbon Head of Platform role (Oct 2026)

pieces.body: I am going through the hiring process for the Senior Firmware Engineer position at Halvorsen Robotics, a Trondheim warehouse-automation company, after a referral from my former colleague Ingrid Sæther. The steps so far were a screening call with recruiter Tomas Berg on 2 September 2026 (fully remote within European time zones, one on-site week in Trondheim per quarter, salary band NOK 950,000–1,150,000 a year plus up to 10% bonus), a technical interview on 9 September 2026 with Ingrid and Aksel Moe where I felt weakest on IEC 61508 safety certification, and a final video round on 16 September 2026 with VP of Engineering Lene Haugland, who said a decision was expected by the end of September. As of 18 September 2026 I told Lene my notice period with my current client is six weeks, so my earliest start date would be 2 November 2026.

pieces.body: I signed a freelance contract with Oakhurst Media, a Dublin podcast network, on 26 March 2026 to rebuild the iOS client of its listener app. It runs from 6 April to 30 September 2026 at a day rate of €720, up from the €650 Oakhurst first offered, for four days a week with Fridays kept free for my other clients. Payment is 30 days from invoice, invoiced monthly; I accepted 30 days instead of the 15 I asked for in exchange for the higher rate. Invoices go to Oakhurst's accounts address as PDFs with the purchase order number. My contacts there are Siobhán Kelly (head of product) and Marek Novak (engineering lead). The contract has an NDA that forbids me from naming Oakhurst's unreleased features publicly, I may list Oakhurst as a client in my portfolio, IP transfers to Oakhurst on payment, and either side can end it with 14 days' notice. I want to turn this into a longer engagement if the first release goes well.
pieces.title: Oakhurst Media freelance iOS contract (April–September 2026)

pieces.body: I gave the talk "Offline-first sync without tears" at NordicSwift 2026 in Oslo on 24 September 2026. It was my first conference talk in English; before, I had only spoken at local meetups in Lisbon. The 30-minute talk plus Q&A covered CRDT conflict resolution in a SwiftData app, using Tern as the example, and about 250 people attended. The feedback forms gave it 4.6 out of 5; several people said the live demo was the best part, and two said the CRDT section was too fast.
pieces.title: NordicSwift 2026 talk "Offline-first sync without tears" in Oslo

El usuario piensa viajar desde Lisboa con su pareja, Rui
pieces.body: Mi hermana Lucía se casa con Tomás Ferreyra el 12 de junio de 2027 en una estancia cerca de San Antonio de Areco, en la provincia de Buenos Aires. La ceremonia civil es a las 17:00, seguida de una cena para unas 120 personas. Lucía me pidió que sea el padrino y que diga unas palabras durante la cena; acepté, aunque me pone nervioso hablar en público. Pienso viajar desde Lisboa con mi pareja, Rui, y quedarme tres semanas en Argentina, también para visitar a mis padres en Rosario. Todavía no compré los pasajes; quiero comprarlos antes de fin de año. Lucía pidió que no lleven regalos y que, si quieren, aporten al fondo para la luna de miel en Japón; yo quiero que mi regalo sea pagar una noche del viaje. La organizadora es Marina Ocampo, y hay que confirmar asistencia antes del 1 de marzo de 2027 en un formulario en línea.
pieces.title: Boda de mi hermana Lucía con Tomás Ferreyra (12 de junio de 2027)

header.title: Interview loop at Verdant Grid (Staff Data Engineer)

evidence: The user completed the interview loop for the Staff Data Engineer role last week.
The salary range they gave was DKK 85,000–95,000 a month.
They expect to hear back by Friday next week.
pieces.body: I completed the four-interview loop for the Staff Data Engineer role at Verdant Grid, a Copenhagen-based (about 120 employees) maker of electricity grid forecasting software, in the week before 14 October 2026. In the system design interview with Mette, I was asked to design a smart-meter readings pipeline, and she praised my enthusiasm and my questions about data quality. Hiring manager Jonas said the role is fully remote with a yearly team week in Copenhagen, and that the team works in Python and dbt on Snowflake. I was weaker in the live SQL exercise and ran out of time on the last window-function question. The recruiter asked about visa sponsorship (I don't need it, as an EU citizen) and I sent my resume as a PDF the same day. The salary range I gave was DKK 85,000–95,000 a month, and I would negotiate for 100,000 a month if an offer comes. I expect to hear back by the Friday of the following week. I like that the product is about the energy transition, but I'm unsure about the pay, which is below my current freelance income.
pieces.title: Verdant Grid Staff Data Engineer interview loop (October 2026)

evidence: Yesterday the user had a call with Marta Sousa, an independent recruiter, about a CTO position at Lumen Health

pieces.body: On 1 September 2026 I had a call with recruiter Marta Sousa about a CTO role at Lumen Health, a 35-person Porto startup that makes appointment software for dental clinics. The role pays €110,000 a year plus 1.5% equity vesting over four years with a one-year cliff, and it is hybrid, with two days a week in the Porto office. I have not decided whether to continue. I plan to discuss it with my partner and told Marta I would reply by the end of the week of 7 September 2026. Marta asked me to keep the conversation private because the current CTO has not announced that he is leaving.
pieces.title: Lumen Health CTO recruiter call, 1 September 2026
